QUOTE: The callback's return value is never read. Registering `on_tool_call` makes every non-denied call run.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the callback cannot refuse and that `approved = true` is set unconditionally after it fires ("if !approved and on_tool_call set → approved = true ← callback is notify-only"). It doesn't say the callback returns void, but the mechanism is the same.
